content: Refined Twitter by sindresorhus, and forks by cstigler and nealrs, forced the mobile-web version of Twitter for a simplified UI, hid promoted tweets, auto-loaded new tweets when scrolled to top, embedded linked Instagram photos inline, added code-block syntax highlighting, reduced notification padding, added a dark-mode hotkey, and an extensive keyboard-shortcut set. The original project is dead because Twitter's site rewrite completely broke it and it was never revived, illustrating how fragile improve-the-real-DOM extensions are against full frontend rewrites.
